hook: Who holds the Guinness record for sport's longest win streak? Not the craziest part.
story: The sport is squash: two players sealed in a walled court, taking turns to hit the same ball off the front wall, until one of them breaks. In 1979, his older brother Torsam - also a professional - collapsed and died mid-match at a tournament in Adelaide. Jahangir Khan was fifteen. He nearly quit; instead, he made the game his tribute. World champion at seventeen, the youngest ever. And then he stopped losing entirely.
number: From 1981 to 1986 he won 555 consecutive matches. Guinness lists it as the longest winning streak in top-level professional sport; the next-longest, in any game, is 470. When Ross Norman finally beat him, in a World Open final, five years had passed between defeats.
closer: Number two on that list, at 470 wins? Esther Vergeer.
